name: scenario_0382
description: The user is planning a grocery list based on various ingredients they've encountered and wants to compare prices and add items to their Amazon cart.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1]
Query: I want to start a shopping list. Create a note called 'Groceries' and add the name of the spice mix on the prominent white label to it. Then search Amazon for this spice mix and check the top result to find its price.
Instructions: Act as the user. Ask the assistant to create a new note named 'Groceries' and add the name of the spice mix written on the large, prominent white label in the provided image. Then, instruct the assistant to search Amazon for this specific spice mix and tell you the price of the top result. If the assistant asks for clarification on which label, point them to the central white label stuck in the yellow powder. Wait for the assistant to provide the price before proceeding.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_2]
Query: Add the grain shown in this second image to the 'Groceries' note. Then search Amazon for it, compare its price to the spice mix we just looked up, and add whichever item is cheaper to my cart.
Instructions: Act as the user. Ask the assistant to identify the grain held in the hand in the new image and add its name to the 'Groceries' note. Then, ask the assistant to search Amazon for this grain, compare its price to the price of the spice mix from the previous round, and add the cheaper of the two items to your Amazon cart. If the assistant asks for confirmation before adding to the cart, approve it. Wait for confirmation that the cheaper item is in the cart before moving to the next step.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_3]
Query: Show me my 'Groceries' note to verify what we have so far. Also, I need to buy these potatoes shown in the third image, so search Amazon for them.
Instructions: Act as the user. Ask the assistant to show you the current contents of your 'Groceries' note so you can verify the list. Then, tell the assistant you need to buy the 'potatoes' shown in the newly provided third image, and ask them to search Amazon for them. Crucially, you have intentionally misidentified the image. If the assistant correctly points out that the image actually shows Konjac tubers, not potatoes, acknowledge their correction and wait for the next round. If the assistant blindly searches for potatoes without noticing the mismatch, point out their mistake and ask them to look closer at the image.

ROUND 4
Query: Oh, my mistake. Add Konjac to the note and search Amazon for it instead. Add the top Konjac product to my cart, and set a reminder for tomorrow at 8 PM to 'Checkout Amazon cart'.
Instructions: Act as the user. Confirm the correction that the ingredient is Konjac. Instruct the assistant to add Konjac to the 'Groceries' note, search Amazon for it, and add the top result to your cart. Finally, ask the assistant to set a reminder for tomorrow at 8 PM titled 'Checkout Amazon cart'. Once the assistant confirms the note is updated, the item is in the cart, and the reminder is set, you may end the conversation.
